heroHeadline: Day 780: Search-Collective Mother Survives Attempted Abduction; Six Separate Shootings Hit Culiacán Over Six Days
heroSubtitle: 780 days of cartel civil war: on September 6, hooded men attempted to forcibly abduct search-collective member Yodeli Benítez near her home in front of her two children — she resisted and the attackers fled, marking the second attack on a searcher in Culiacán in two weeks. The same day, a wave of separate shootings across Tierra Blanca, Felipe Ángeles and Bosques del Álamo killed one man and wounded three more. Non-fatal shootings continued September 10–11 in Chula Vista, an armed pursuit through Los Mezcales and Loma de Rodriguera, and near the Culiacán municipal landfill. The violence follows a bloody stretch on September 4 (Tepuche's síndico kidnapped and killed) and September 8 (a Federal Protection Force patrol ambushed on Highway Mexico 15, followed by an overnight wave of shootings and vehicle fires). Days of open civil war: 780+.
